timothy2.2.p1.b1.text: You therefore, my child, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

timothy2.2.p1.b2.text: And the things that you have heard me say among many witnesses,

timothy2.2.p1.b3.text: entrust these to faithful men who will be qualified to teach others as well.

timothy2.2.p2.b1.text: Join me in suffering, like a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

timothy2.2.p2.b2.text: A soldier refrains from entangling himself in civilian affairs …

timothy2.2.p2.b3.text: Likewise, a competitor does not receive the crown unless he competes according to the rules.

timothy2.2.p2.b4.text: The hardworking farmer should be the first to partake of the crops.

timothy2.2.p3.b1.text: Remember Jesus Christ, raised from the dead, descended from David …

timothy2.2.p3.b2.text: for which I suffer to the extent of being chained like a criminal. But the word of God cannot be chained!

timothy2.2.p3.b3.text: For this reason I endure all things for the sake of the elect …

timothy2.2.p4.b1.text: This is a trustworthy saying: If we died with Him, we will also live with Him;

timothy2.2.p4.b2.text: if we endure, we will also reign with Him;

timothy2.2.p4.b3.text: if we deny Him, He will also deny us;

timothy2.2.p4.b4.text: if we are faithless, He remains faithful, for He cannot deny Himself.

timothy2.2.p5.b1.text: … avoid quarreling over words, which succeeds only in leading the listeners to ruin.

timothy2.2.p5.b2.text: Make every effort to present yourself approved to God, an unashamed workman who accurately handles the word of truth.

timothy2.2.p5.b3.text: and the talk of such men will spread like gangrene. Among them are Hymenaeus and Philetus,

timothy2.2.p5.b4.text: who have deviated from the truth. They say that the resurrection has already occurred, and they undermine the faith of some.

timothy2.2.p6.b1.text: Nevertheless, God’s firm foundation stands, bearing this seal: “The Lord knows those who are His,” …

timothy2.2.p6.b2.text: A large house contains not only vessels of gold and silver, but also of wood and clay. Some indeed are for honorable use, but others are for common use.

timothy2.2.p6.b3.text: So if anyone cleanses himself of what is unfit, he will be a vessel for honor: sanctified, useful to the Master …

timothy2.2.p7.b1.text: Flee from youthful passions and pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace, together with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

timothy2.2.p7.b2.text: And a servant of the Lord must not be quarrelsome, but must be kind to everyone, able to teach, and forbearing.

timothy2.2.p7.b3.text: He must gently reprove those who oppose him, in the hope that God may grant them repentance leading to a knowledge of the truth.

timothy2.2.p7.b4.text: … they will come to their senses and escape the snare of the devil …
